items.reason: The 1970 offshore petroleum statute has nothing comparable in the Taiwan baseline (no resource legislation before 1970, only the 1963/1968 Nansha guano office), so if it covers the SCS islands' shelf it would be a novelty move; but it names no SCS feature and was drafted for the East China Sea/Taiwan Strait shelf. Settled by whether the statute or its implementing concessions reach Pratas or Spratly waters; otherwise likely reject as outside the SCS.

Warning shots by the Itu Aba garrison at Philippine aircraft and boats (incl. Rep. Mitra's) are a coercive method with nothing comparable in 1970 (only the petroleum statute ev-9aac2dceda); the 1956 boardings in the baseline do not count against novelty. Rests on Philippine accounts alone (Marcos statement), so a coder may want ROC corroboration.

The Foreign Minister's public rejection in Manila of Marcos's withdrawal demand is the first verbal assertion of the Spratly claim in the run, nothing comparable in 1970 (ev-9aac2dceda is a shelf statute naming no feature); a declarative reaction distinct from the garrison's warning shots ev-fd8b5b448d.

Lead of the 1973 protest series (four protests listed by MOFA on 18 Jan 1974): diplomatic protests to rival claimants, against nothing comparable in 1972 (no candidates); the 1971 public statement ev-06c5a9367e was absent in 1972, so the practice is new again.
Second of the four 1973 protests from the same MOFA list; part of the protest series led by ev-fc74ad4d38.
Third of the four 1973 protests from the same MOFA list; part of the protest series led by ev-fc74ad4d38.
Fourth of the four 1973 protests (probably answering South Vietnam's September 1973 Phuoc Tuy decree); part of the protest series led by ev-fc74ad4d38.

Against 1973's protests (ev-fc74ad4d38 and three others), which were private and named only the Nansha and Hsisha, the 18 Jan 1974 MOFA statement is a public reassertion extending to all four groups (Pratas and Macclesfield added); scope, arguably novelty of method (public statement vs. protest). A coder applying the counterfactual may see it as reaction to the PRC-SVN crisis at the same level.

Unattributed government statement via UPI that the Spratly claim will not be renounced and the garrison kept; part of the same 1974 public reassertion led by ev-a3b1a78dee, not a separate intensification.
A diplomatic reply restating the claim to the Philippines continues the 1973 practice of protests to rival claimants (ev-fc74ad4d38 series) at the same level; provisional until 1973 is decided.

Formal protest to South Vietnam over the Spratlys continues the 1973 protest practice (ev-fc74ad4d38 series, probably also addressed to Saigon) at the same level; if 1973's protests were not delivered by summoning the envoy, a coder may read the call-in of the chargé as a novelty of method.

Quarterly resupply of the Itu Aba garrison held since 1956 (baseline) is maintenance, and MOFA said the garrison was neither withdrawn nor strengthened; no 1973 candidate records the resupply runs to name as continued. Not an intensification on the sources — likely reject as maintenance unless the escort's role during the RVN landing is judged a show of force.
The 1975 resupply and troop-rotation run is the same quarterly practice as the February 1974 run ev-21e8304a9d, with no change in ships or stationing; provisional until 1974 is decided.

Public government reiteration of the Paracel and Spratly claim, answering South Vietnam's white paper, continues the 1974 public reassertion ev-a3b1a78dee at the same level; provisional until 1974 is decided.

The CGA history's 1975 'one and only valid legal warning' has no date or text and may be the 15 Feb reiteration ev-d55ce9b4cc (then a continuation of 1974's ev-a3b1a78dee); if it was a distinct warning conveying a threat, or the first addressed to Malaysia, it could be a novelty or scope move. Settled by finding the warning's text and date.

MND statement that the troops still hold Itu Aba repeats the 1974 public line that the garrison would be maintained (ev-907159dbc4, in the group led by ev-a3b1a78dee), with no change on the ground; provisional until 1974 is decided.
Public reiteration of the Spratly and Paracel claim, the same practice as the 15 Feb 1975 reiteration ev-d55ce9b4cc; provisional until 1975 is decided.

June 1976 government statements on the islands, known only from a cable title, are on the record a further reiteration of the kind seen in 1975 (ev-d55ce9b4cc); provisional, and their unknown content (a protest of the Reed Bank drilling?) could change the call.

A visit by the Chief of the General Staff to the Pratas garrison, with a stele erected, is a top-level display of presence with nothing comparable in 1975 (only Spratly resupply ev-9a9ad21bd5 and statements); low salience, and a coder may judge such inspection visits routine and unreported in other years.

A new monsoon-monitoring station on Taiping Island adds scientific equipment to the held feature, nothing comparable in 1977 (no candidates); the existing weather office (baseline 1960) does not count against novelty. A coder may read the WMO programme as cooperative and reject.

First 12-nm territorial sea and 200-nm EEZ, replacing the three-mile limit; a new legal method against 1978's station ev-b6606d2062. Covers the SCS islands only implicitly (names none), and a coder may type it coercive under the baselines rule.

Placing Pratas under the new Kaohsiung special municipality is a new administrative arrangement, nothing comparable in 1978 (ev-b6606d2062 is a Spratly station); separate from the EEZ decree ev-ea7a173eee. Date and instrument unverified (year only).
